```tsx
  const message = property ? property.value === undefined ? 'Property not set' : typeof property.value === 'boolean' ? `Validated boolean: ${String(property.value)}` : 'Expected a boolean' : undefined;
  const regions: DemoRegions = {
    controls: <>
      <Field label="Catalog URL"><Input aria-label="Catalog URL" value={catalog} onChange={(_, data) => { if (current()) { boundary.current = { ...boundary.current, catalog: data.value, token: {} }; setCatalog(data.value); } }}/></Field>
      <Field label="Property key"><Input aria-label="Property key" value={key} onChange={(_, data) => { if (current()) { boundary.current = { ...boundary.current, key: data.value, token: {} }; setKey(data.value); } }}/></Field>
    </>,
    commands: <Button appearance="primary" disabled={!service || !catalog.trim() || !key || visible?.pending} onClick={read}>Read</Button>,
    status: visible?.failure ? <Text role="alert">{visible.failure}</Text> : <Text role="status">{visible?.pending ? 'Reading StorageEntity...' : message ?? 'Supply the known tenant catalog URL and Read explicitly.'}</Text>,
    children: property ? <dl aria-label="StorageEntity result"><dt>Value type</dt><dd>{property.value === undefined ? '(not set)' : typeof property.value}</dd>
      <dt>Description</dt><dd>{property.description === undefined ? '(not set)' : typeof property.description === 'string' ? JSON.stringify(property.description) : '(legacy description unavailable)'}</dd></dl> : undefined,
    diagnostics: <>
      <Text as="p">This factory does not discover the catalog, cache values, provision a list or write data. A current web URL is not a catalog address. HTTP 403/404 and malformed response JSON are failures. A missing or legacy REST-null Value means absence and clears its description. Defined stored text is decoded JSON-first; invalid stored JSON falls back to a string and fails this boolean validator.</Text>
      <Text as="p">Description metadata is passed through by the legacy service. Empty descriptions remain visible as quoted empty text; legacy null metadata is shown as unavailable. Reset clears inputs/results and invalidates publication, without cancelling an already-started read.</Text>
      {property && <div className={styles.payload} role="region" aria-label="Raw StorageEntity result" tabIndex={0}><pre>{JSON.stringify(property, undefined, 2)}</pre></div>}
    </>,
  };
  return render ? render(regions) : <>{regions.controls}{regions.commands}{regions.status}{regions.children}{regions.diagnostics}</>;
}
export const demo = { host: 'webPart', kind: 'read', contentPlacement: 'configuration', observe: 'Read a StorageEntity from the supplied catalog and distinguish validated boolean data from missing, malformed or failed data.' };
```

## Explore tenant list records safely

Activate the tenant-store hook session explicitly before its initial catalog discovery and effective permission checks. Client readiness does not mean discovery has completed or that a write is authorized. The logical scope is the tenant app-catalog store resolved internally for the captured discovery-web, collection, client, PageContext and host session. The hook does not expose its physical catalog URL; the discovery-web address is not a catalog address. A changed session requires explicit reactivation.

Use disposable keys with a nonempty `spfx-toolkit-tenant-demo-` suffix and consent to the displayed exact operation, value and description policy. Ordinary Save and Remove have no automatic readback. The separate numeric-text recipe saves `'123'` with `'Application version'`, then reads explicitly; a failed read after a completed save is partial success. The direct service recipe uses only an explicitly supplied known catalog URL and has no discovery or permission API.

Reset restores local UI and consent, retaining the original pending public-write lock even when its hook child unmounts. Already-dispatched setup, mutation and recovery requests may finish; Reset does not cancel, roll back or remove a stored record. No stale sequence may begin a later public read. Locks belong to each still-mounted Demo and do not serialize other scenarios.

#### Explore tenant records and exact text persistence

```tsx
import * as React from 'react';
import { makeStyles, Accordion, AccordionHeader, AccordionItem, AccordionPanel, Button, Checkbox, Dialog, DialogActions, DialogBody, DialogContent, DialogSurface, DialogTitle, Field, Input, Select, Text } from '@fluentui/react-components';
import { useSPFxInstanceInfo, useSPFxPageContext, useSPFxTenantKeyValueStore, useSPFxSPHttpClient } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit';
import type { SPFxTenantKeyValueStoreItem } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit';

type DemoRegions = { controls?: React.ReactNode; commands?: React.ReactNode; status?: React.ReactNode; diagnostics?: React.ReactNode; children?: React.ReactNode };
type Presenter = (regions: DemoRegions) => React.ReactElement;
type Session = { generation: object; root: string; web: string; client: unknown; page: unknown; instance: string };
type Action = 'get' | 'list' | 'save' | 'remove' | 'roundtrip';
type Format = 'text' | 'json' | 'bigint' | 'date';
const useStyles = makeStyles({ payload: { overflowX: 'auto', maxWidth: '100%', minWidth: 0 } });
type Ticket = { promise?: Promise<void> };

function present(regions: DemoRegions, render?: Presenter): React.ReactElement {
  return render ? render(regions) : <>{regions.controls}{regions.commands}{regions.status}{regions.children}{regions.diagnostics}</>;
}

// This bounded child owns the hook session. Reset deliberately unmounts it.
function TenantSession({ session, current, write, pending, isLocked, render }: {
  session: Session; current: () => boolean; write: (operation: () => Promise<void>) => Promise<void> | undefined;
  pending: boolean; isLocked: () => boolean; render?: Presenter;
}): React.ReactElement {
  const store = useSPFxTenantKeyValueStore();
  const styles = useStyles();
  const [action, setAction] = React.useState<Action>('get');
  const [key, setKey] = React.useState('spfx-toolkit-tenant-demo-disposable');
  const [value, setValue] = React.useState('');
  const [format, setFormat] = React.useState<Format>('text');
  const [replaceDescription, setReplaceDescription] = React.useState(false);
  const [description, setDescription] = React.useState('Disposable SPFx React Toolkit tenant demo item');
  const [consent, setConsent] = React.useState<object>();
  const approval = React.useRef<object>();
  approval.current = consent;
  const approve = (next: object | undefined): void => { approval.current = next; setConsent(next); };
  const [outcome, setOutcome] = React.useState<{ boundary: object; action: Action; message?: string; failure?: string; persisted?: boolean; reading?: boolean; item?: SPFxTenantKeyValueStoreItem; items?: SPFxTenantKeyValueStoreItem[] }>();
  const boundary = React.useRef({ fingerprint: '', token: {} });
  const fingerprint = JSON.stringify([action, key, value, format, replaceDescription, description]);
  if (boundary.current.fingerprint !== fingerprint) boundary.current = { fingerprint, token: {} };
  const target = boundary.current.token;
  const latest = React.useRef(0);
  const sequence = React.useRef<object>();
  const [, refreshSession] = React.useState(0);
  const mounted = React.useRef(true);
  const confirmationRef = React.useRef<object>();
  const restoreFocus = React.useRef<{ trigger: HTMLButtonElement; current: () => boolean }>();
  const [confirmation, setConfirmation] = React.useState<{ token: object; confirm: () => void; cancel: () => void; key: string }>();
  React.useLayoutEffect(() => {
    const request = restoreFocus.current;
    if (!confirmation && request) { restoreFocus.current = undefined; if (request.current() && request.trigger.isConnected) request.trigger.focus(); }
  }, [confirmation]);
  React.useLayoutEffect(() => { mounted.current = true; return () => { mounted.current = false; confirmationRef.current = undefined; }; }, []);
  const valid = (): boolean => mounted.current && current() && boundary.current.token === target;
  const disposable = key.startsWith('spfx-toolkit-tenant-demo-') && key.length > 'spfx-toolkit-tenant-demo-'.length;
  const visible = valid() && outcome?.boundary === target ? outcome : undefined;
  const reading = visible?.action === 'get' || visible?.action === 'list' || visible?.reading === true;
  // The public read resolves a fallback. Its CURRENT rendered error takes precedence.
  const failure = visible ? visible.failure ?? (reading ? store.error?.message : store.writeError?.message) : undefined;
  const locked = pending || confirmation !== undefined || sequence.current === target;
  const edit = (change: () => void): void => {
    if (!valid() || locked || sequence.current === target || isLocked() || confirmationRef.current) return;
    // Retire captured consent/commands synchronously, before a batched React commit.
    boundary.current = { ...boundary.current, token: {} }; approve(undefined); change(); refreshSession(count => count + 1);
  };

  const run = async (trigger: HTMLButtonElement): Promise<void> => {
    if (!valid() || sequence.current === target || isLocked() || pending || confirmationRef.current || !store.isReady || store.isLoading || store.isWriting) return;
    if (action !== 'list' && !key) return;
    const mutating = action === 'save' || action === 'remove' || action === 'roundtrip';
    if (mutating && (!disposable || approval.current !== target)) return;
    const operation = ++latest.current;
    const owns = (): boolean => valid() && latest.current === operation;
    const execute = async (remove?: () => Promise<void>): Promise<void> => {
      if (!owns() || isLocked()) return;
      if (mutating) sequence.current = target;
      setOutcome({ boundary: target, action });
      try {
        if (action === 'get') {
          const item = await store.get(key);
          if (owns()) setOutcome({ boundary: target, action, item, message: item ? `Found ${key}.` : `${key} not found.` });
        } else if (action === 'list') {
          const items = await store.list();
          if (owns()) setOutcome({ boundary: target, action, items, message: `Loaded ${items.length} tenant key-value item(s).` });
        } else {
          let input: unknown = value;
          if (action === 'save') {
            if (format === 'json') input = JSON.parse(value);
            else if (format === 'bigint') input = BigInt(value);
            else if (format === 'date') { const date = new Date(value); if (!Number.isFinite(date.getTime())) throw new Error('Enter a valid Date.'); input = date; }
          }
          // The parent retains the ORIGINAL public promise through Reset/child unmount.
          const promise = write(remove ?? (() => action === 'roundtrip' ? store.save(key, '123', 'Application version') : replaceDescription ? store.save(key, input, description) : store.save(key, input)));
          if (!promise) return;
          await promise;
          if (!owns()) return;
          approve(undefined);
          if (action === 'roundtrip') {
            setOutcome({ boundary: target, action, persisted: true, reading: true });
            const item = await store.get<unknown>(key);
            if (owns()) setOutcome({ boundary: target, action, persisted: true, reading: true, item, message: item?.value === '123' && typeof item.value === 'string' ? 'Read back exact text 123 (string).' : 'Readback did not contain exact text 123.' });
          } else setOutcome({ boundary: target, action, message: `${action === 'save' ? 'Saved' : 'Removed'} ${key}.` });
        }
      } catch (error) {
        if (owns()) setOutcome(previous => ({ ...previous, boundary: target, action, failure: error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error) }));
      } finally { if (sequence.current === target) sequence.current = undefined; if (mounted.current) refreshSession(count => count + 1); }
    };
    if (action !== 'remove') { await execute(); return; }
    const token = {};
    const remove = store.remove;
    const capturedKey = key;
    confirmationRef.current = token;
    const cancel = (): void => {
      if (!owns() || confirmationRef.current !== token) return;
      restoreFocus.current = { trigger, current: owns };
      confirmationRef.current = undefined; setConfirmation(undefined);
    };
    const confirm = (): Promise<void> | undefined => {
      if (!owns() || confirmationRef.current !== token || approval.current !== target) return;
      confirmationRef.current = undefined; setConfirmation(undefined);
      return execute(() => remove(capturedKey));
    };
    setConfirmation({ token, confirm, cancel, key: capturedKey });
  };
  const shownValue = (item: SPFxTenantKeyValueStoreItem): string => typeof item.value === 'string' ? JSON.stringify(item.value) : JSON.stringify(item.value) ?? String(item.value);
  const regions: DemoRegions = {
    controls: <>
      <Field label="Operation"><Select aria-label="Operation" disabled={locked} value={action} onChange={(_, data) => edit(() => setAction(data.value as Action))}><option value="get">Read</option><option value="list">List</option><option value="save">Save</option><option value="remove">Remove</option><option value="roundtrip">Save and read numeric-looking text</option></Select></Field>
      {action !== 'list' && <Field label="Key"><Input aria-label="Key" disabled={locked} value={key} onChange={(_, data) => edit(() => setKey(data.value))}/></Field>}
      {action === 'save' && <>
        <Field label="Value format"><Select aria-label="Value format" disabled={locked} value={format} onChange={(_, data) => edit(() => setFormat(data.value as Format))}><option value="text">Text</option><option value="json">JSON</option><option value="bigint">Big integer</option><option value="date">Date (ISO)</option></Select></Field>
        <Field label="Value"><Input aria-label="Value" disabled={locked} value={value} onChange={(_, data) => edit(() => setValue(data.value))}/></Field>
        <Checkbox label="Replace/clear destination description" disabled={locked} checked={replaceDescription} onChange={(_, data) => edit(() => setReplaceDescription(data.checked === true))}/>
        <Field label="Description"><Input aria-label="Description" disabled={locked || !replaceDescription} value={description} onChange={(_, data) => edit(() => setDescription(data.value))}/></Field>
      </>}
      {(action === 'save' || action === 'remove' || action === 'roundtrip') && <>
        <Text as="p">{action} in the tenant app-catalog store resolved internally for this captured discovery session; key {key}; {action === 'roundtrip' ? 'exact text "123" and description "Application version"' : `format ${format}; value ${JSON.stringify(value)}; ${replaceDescription ? `description ${JSON.stringify(description)}` : 'preserve destination description'}`}. Saving may provision or repair the store.</Text>
        <Checkbox label="I consent to this exact disposable mutation" disabled={locked || !disposable} checked={consent === target} onChange={(_, data) => { if (!locked && sequence.current !== target && valid() && !isLocked() && !confirmationRef.current && valid()) approve(data.checked === true ? target : undefined); }}/>
      </>}
    </>,
    commands: <Button appearance="primary" disabled={!store.isReady || store.isLoading || store.isWriting || locked || (action !== 'list' && !key) || ((action === 'save' || action === 'remove' || action === 'roundtrip') && (!disposable || approval.current !== target))} onClick={event => run(event.currentTarget)}>{action === 'roundtrip' ? 'Save and read numeric-looking text' : 'Run'}</Button>,
    status: <>{visible?.persisted && <Text role="status">Saved {key}. The subsequent read is a separate step.</Text>}{failure ? <Text role="alert">{failure}</Text> : visible?.message ? <Text role="status">{visible.message}</Text> : <Text>Run the selected operation.</Text>}</>,
    children: <>
      <dl aria-label="Tenant store state"><dt>Client ready</dt><dd>{String(store.isReady)}</dd><dt>Can Write</dt><dd>{String(store.canWrite)}</dd><dt>Loading</dt><dd>{String(Boolean(visible) && store.isLoading)}</dd><dt>Writing</dt><dd>{String(pending)}</dd><dt>Collection root URL</dt><dd>{session.root}</dd><dt>Discovery web URL</dt><dd>{session.web}</dd></dl>
      {!failure && visible?.item && <dl aria-label="Selected tenant record"><dt>Selected key</dt><dd>{visible.item.key}</dd><dt>Selected value</dt><dd>{shownValue(visible.item)}{visible.item.value === '' ? ' (empty string)' : ''}</dd><dt>Value type</dt><dd>{typeof visible.item.value}</dd><dt>Description</dt><dd>{visible.item.description ?? '(not set)'}</dd></dl>}
      {!failure && visible?.items && <><Text>Inventory count: {visible.items.length}</Text><dl aria-label="First ten tenant records">{visible.items.slice(0, 10).map((item, index) => <React.Fragment key={index}><dt>{item.key}</dt><dd>{shownValue(item)}</dd></React.Fragment>)}</dl></>}
      <Dialog open={confirmation !== undefined} onOpenChange={(_, data) => { if (!data.open) confirmation?.cancel(); }}><DialogSurface><DialogBody><DialogTitle>Confirm exact tenant removal</DialogTitle><DialogContent>Remove {confirmation?.key} in the tenant app-catalog store resolved internally for this captured discovery session. This cannot be undone by Reset.</DialogContent><DialogActions><Button onClick={confirmation?.cancel}>Cancel</Button><Button appearance="primary" onClick={confirmation?.confirm}>Confirm removal</Button></DialogActions></DialogBody></DialogSurface></Dialog>
    </>,
    diagnostics: <>
      <Text as="p">All sites share TenantKeyValueStore in the tenant app catalog. Physical catalog URL is unavailable through this hook API. The discovery-web and collection-root URLs identify the captured client/PageContext/host session; neither is a catalog address. Client ready means client availability, not completed discovery or authorization. Can Write is an effective indicator, not authorization or a prerequisite for an otherwise consented hook request. SharePoint enforces grants; schema changes may need additional rights. Reads/removal never provision. Normal Save/Remove does not read back automatically. ETags guard the service snapshot, not an earlier Read. Bigint and Date read as strings. Reset hides results; dispatched writes can still complete. This local lock does not serialize other scenarios.</Text>
      {!failure && visible && <Accordion collapsible><AccordionItem value="payload"><AccordionHeader>Full tenant payload</AccordionHeader><AccordionPanel><div role="region" aria-label="Full tenant payload" tabIndex={0} className={styles.payload}><pre>{JSON.stringify(visible.item ?? visible.items, undefined, 2)}</pre></div></AccordionPanel></AccordionItem></Accordion>}
    </>,
  };
  return present(regions, render);
}

export function Demo({ render, resetRevision = 0 }: { render?: Presenter; resetRevision?: number } = {}): React.ReactElement {
  const page = useSPFxPageContext();
  const { client } = useSPFxSPHttpClient();
  const info = useSPFxInstanceInfo();
  const root = page.site.absoluteUrl.trim().replace(/\/+$/, '');
  const web = page.web.absoluteUrl.trim().replace(/\/+$/, '');
  const boundary = React.useRef({ revision: resetRevision, root, web, client, page, instance: info.id, generation: {} });
  const previous = boundary.current;
  if (previous.revision !== resetRevision || previous.root !== root || previous.web !== web || previous.client !== client || previous.page !== page || previous.instance !== info.id) boundary.current = { revision: resetRevision, root, web, client, page, instance: info.id, generation: {} };
  const generation = boundary.current.generation;
  const [session, setSession] = React.useState<Session>();
  const ledger = React.useRef(new Set<Ticket>());
  const [, refresh] = React.useState(0);
  const mounted = React.useRef(true);
  React.useLayoutEffect(() => { mounted.current = true; return () => { mounted.current = false; }; }, []);
  const current = (): boolean => mounted.current && boundary.current.generation === generation && page.web.absoluteUrl.trim().replace(/\/+$/, '') === web && page.site.absoluteUrl.trim().replace(/\/+$/, '') === root;
  const write = (operation: () => Promise<void>): Promise<void> | undefined => {
    if (!current() || ledger.current.size > 0) return undefined;
    const ticket: Ticket = {}; ledger.current.add(ticket); refresh(count => count + 1);
    const release = (): void => { ledger.current.delete(ticket); if (mounted.current) refresh(count => count + 1); };
    try { const promise = operation(); ticket.promise = promise; return promise.finally(release); }
    catch (error) { release(); throw error; }
  };
  const active = session?.generation === generation;
  const pending = ledger.current.size > 0;
  const activate = (): void => {
    if (!current() || ledger.current.size > 0 || active || !client || !root) return;
    setSession({ generation, root, web, client, page, instance: info.id });
  };
  // The outer activation control remains the same DOM node across child teardown.
  return <>
    <Button disabled={active || pending || !client || !root} onClick={activate}>Activate tenant store</Button>
    {pending && <Text role="status">Previous write still pending</Text>}
    {active && session ? <TenantSession session={session} current={current} write={write} pending={pending} isLocked={() => ledger.current.size > 0} render={render}/> : present({ children: <Text>Activate the tenant store to permit read-only catalog discovery and effective permission initialization. Reset does not cancel server work.</Text> }, render)}
  </>;
}
export const demo = { host: 'webPart', kind: 'write', contentPlacement: 'configuration', observe: 'Activate the tenant store, preserve numeric-looking and empty text, and run physical reads or consented mutations with current-only results.' };
```

#### Round trip numeric looking text through a tenant service

```tsx
import * as React from 'react';
import { makeStyles, Button, Checkbox, Field, Input, Text } from '@fluentui/react-components';
import { createSPFxTenantKeyValueStoreService, useSPFxInstanceInfo, useSPFxPageContext, useSPFxSPHttpClient } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit';
import type { SPFxTenantKeyValueStoreServiceItem } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit';

type DemoRegions = { controls?: React.ReactNode; commands?: React.ReactNode; status?: React.ReactNode; diagnostics?: React.ReactNode; children?: React.ReactNode };
type Ticket = { promise?: Promise<void> };
const useStyles = makeStyles({ payload: { overflowX: 'auto', maxWidth: '100%', minWidth: 0 } });
export function Demo({ render, resetRevision = 0 }: { render?: (regions: DemoRegions) => React.ReactElement; resetRevision?: number } = {}): React.ReactElement {
  const page = useSPFxPageContext();
  const { client } = useSPFxSPHttpClient();
  const instance = useSPFxInstanceInfo();
  const styles = useStyles();
  const service = React.useMemo(() => client ? createSPFxTenantKeyValueStoreService(client) : undefined, [client]);
  const web = page.web.absoluteUrl.trim().replace(/\/+$/, '');
  const root = page.site.absoluteUrl.trim().replace(/\/+$/, '');
  const [catalog, setCatalog] = React.useState('');
  const [key, setKey] = React.useState('spfx-toolkit-tenant-demo-service');
  const [consent, setConsent] = React.useState<object>();
  const approval = React.useRef<object>();
  const approve = (next: object | undefined): void => { approval.current = next; setConsent(next); };
  const boundary = React.useRef({ revision: resetRevision, page, client, web, root, instance: instance.id, catalog, key, token: {} });
  const previous = boundary.current;
  if (previous.revision !== resetRevision || previous.page !== page || previous.client !== client || previous.web !== web || previous.root !== root || previous.instance !== instance.id || previous.catalog !== catalog || previous.key !== key) boundary.current = { revision: resetRevision, page, client, web, root, instance: instance.id, catalog, key, token: {} };
  const token = boundary.current.token;
  const mounted = React.useRef(true);
  const ledger = React.useRef(new Set<Ticket>());
  const sequence = React.useRef<object>();
  const [, refresh] = React.useState(0);
  const [outcome, setOutcome] = React.useState<{ token: object; persisted?: boolean; item?: SPFxTenantKeyValueStoreServiceItem; message?: string; failure?: string }>();
  React.useLayoutEffect(() => { mounted.current = true; return () => { mounted.current = false; }; }, []);
  const resetSeen = React.useRef(resetRevision);
  React.useLayoutEffect(() => {
    if (resetSeen.current !== resetRevision) { resetSeen.current = resetRevision; setCatalog(''); setKey('spfx-toolkit-tenant-demo-service'); approve(undefined); setOutcome(undefined); }
  }, [resetRevision]);
  const current = (): boolean => mounted.current && boundary.current.token === token && page.web.absoluteUrl.trim().replace(/\/+$/, '') === web && page.site.absoluteUrl.trim().replace(/\/+$/, '') === root;
  const visible = current() && outcome?.token === token ? outcome : undefined;
  const pending = ledger.current.size > 0;
  const locked = pending || sequence.current === token;
  const disposable = key.startsWith('spfx-toolkit-tenant-demo-') && key.length > 'spfx-toolkit-tenant-demo-'.length;
  const run = async (): Promise<void> => {
    if (!current() || !service || !catalog.trim() || !disposable || approval.current !== token || ledger.current.size > 0 || sequence.current === token) return;
    let url: string;
    try {
      const parsed = new URL(catalog.trim());
      if (!['http:', 'https:'].includes(parsed.protocol) || parsed.username || parsed.password || parsed.search || parsed.hash) throw new Error('Enter an absolute catalog URL without credentials, query or fragment.');
      url = catalog.trim().replace(/\/+$/, '');
    } catch (error) { setOutcome({ token, failure: error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error) }); return; }
    sequence.current = token;
    const ticket: Ticket = {}; ledger.current.add(ticket); approve(undefined); setOutcome(undefined); refresh(count => count + 1);
    const release = (): void => { ledger.current.delete(ticket); if (mounted.current) refresh(count => count + 1); };
    let persisted = false;
    try {
      // Keep the original WHOLE public Save promise, including setup/snapshot/internal RPCs.
      let promise: Promise<void>;
      try { promise = service.save(key, '123', url); ticket.promise = promise; }
      catch (error) { release(); throw error; }
      await promise.finally(release);
      if (!current()) return;
      persisted = true; setOutcome({ token, persisted, message: 'Reading back the saved text...' });
      const item = await service.get<unknown>(key, url);
      if (current()) setOutcome({ token, persisted, item, message: item?.value === '123' && typeof item.value === 'string' ? 'Read back exact text 123 (string).' : 'Readback did not contain exact text 123.' });
    } catch (error) { if (current()) setOutcome({ token, persisted, failure: error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error) }); }
    finally { if (sequence.current === token) sequence.current = undefined; if (mounted.current) refresh(count => count + 1); }
  };
  const regions: DemoRegions = {
    controls: <>
      <Field label="Catalog URL"><Input aria-label="Catalog URL" disabled={locked} value={catalog} onChange={(_, data) => { if (current() && ledger.current.size === 0 && sequence.current !== token) { boundary.current = { ...boundary.current, catalog: data.value, token: {} }; approve(undefined); setCatalog(data.value); } }}/></Field>
      <Field label="Key"><Input aria-label="Key" disabled={locked} value={key} onChange={(_, data) => { if (current() && ledger.current.size === 0 && sequence.current !== token) { boundary.current = { ...boundary.current, key: data.value, token: {} }; approve(undefined); setKey(data.value); } }}/></Field>
      <Text as="p">Save exact text "123" at supplied catalog {catalog || '(required)'}, key {key}; preserve destination description by omitting it. Save may provision or repair TenantKeyValueStore.</Text>
      <Checkbox label="I consent to this exact disposable mutation" checked={consent === token} disabled={locked || !disposable || !catalog.trim()} onChange={(_, data) => { if (current() && ledger.current.size === 0 && sequence.current !== token) approve(data.checked === true ? token : undefined); }}/>
    </>,
    commands: <Button appearance="primary" disabled={!service || !catalog.trim() || !disposable || consent !== token || locked} onClick={run}>Save and read numeric-looking text</Button>,
    status: <>{pending && <Text role="status">Previous write still pending</Text>}{visible?.persisted && <Text role="status">Saved {key}. The subsequent read is a separate step.</Text>}{visible?.failure ? <Text role="alert">{visible.failure}</Text> : <Text role="status">{visible?.message ?? 'Supply a known catalog URL, then explicitly consent to Save and read.'}</Text>}</>,
    children: <dl aria-label="Tenant service result"><dt>Catalog URL</dt><dd>{catalog || '(required)'}</dd><dt>Key</dt><dd>{key}</dd>{visible?.item && <><dt>Selected value</dt><dd>{JSON.stringify(visible.item.value)}</dd><dt>Value type</dt><dd>{typeof visible.item.value}</dd><dt>Description</dt><dd>{visible.item.description ?? '(not set)'}</dd></>}</dl>,
    diagnostics: <><Text as="p">This request-free factory uses only the explicitly supplied catalog URL. It does not discover a catalog or expose a permission API. SharePoint authorizes writes. ETags protect the service's snapshot, not an earlier application read. A completed Save followed by failed Read is partial success. Reset clears local inputs/consent/results; it never removes the key, cancels a dispatched write or rolls back server data. Pending writes retain the local lock until their original public promise settles. Other scenarios have independent locks.</Text><div role="region" aria-label="Tenant service payload" tabIndex={0} className={styles.payload}><pre>{JSON.stringify(visible?.item, undefined, 2)}</pre></div></>,
  };
  return render ? render(regions) : <>{regions.controls}{regions.commands}{regions.status}{regions.children}{regions.diagnostics}</>;
}
export const demo = { host: 'webPart', kind: 'write', contentPlacement: 'configuration', observe: 'Save numeric-looking text through the service at the supplied catalog and read it back as a string.' };
```

## Explore effective configuration and physical stores

The complete hook scenario exposes tenant, site and layered modes with independent physical scope in layered mode. Read resolves the whole effective record; inventory, Save and Remove explicitly select one physical store. Site mode follows the collection root and ignores subsite-only navigation; tenant mode follows the discovery web. The sample initially selects layered mode, while the public API always requires an explicit mode.

Manual Save and Remove never automatically read back. Exact text remains text, including numeric-looking and empty input; JSON, bigint and Date have the documented distinct read-back types. Omitted descriptions preserve destination metadata and explicit empty descriptions clear it. The separate default/override command writes numeric tenant 20 and site 50, reads site provenance, confirms removal of only site, then reads the tenant default. Each completed step remains visible if a later request fails; tenant cleanup is a separate explicit scoped operation.

The factory scenario composes the same physical services directly with the required mode, collection root and discovery web. It additionally inventories site rows, preserving scope-local IDs and duplicates rather than merging stores. Both scenarios show the captured logical tenant destination honestly: the facade exposes no resolved physical catalog URL. An extra diagnostic discovery is not performed.

Consent binds the exact disposable key, physical scope, value and description policy. Changed drafts retire old commands before React commits; no-op edits remain usable. Reset retains the mounted component and original pending public-write tickets until those promises settle. It invalidates stale publication and later recipe steps, without cancelling internal RPCs or rolling back accepted writes. The local gate does not serialize another scenario or host instance. Real writes, provisioning and cleanup require separate host authorization.

#### Compare layered configuration and physical inventories

```tsx
import * as React from 'react';
import { Button, Checkbox, Dialog, DialogActions, DialogBody, DialogContent, DialogSurface, DialogTitle, Field, Input, Select, Text, makeStyles } from '@fluentui/react-components';
import { useSPFxConfigurationStore, useSPFxInstanceInfo, useSPFxPageContext, useSPFxSPHttpClient } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit';
import type { SPFxConfigurationStoreItem, SPFxConfigurationStoreMode, SPFxConfigurationStoreScope } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit';
type DemoRegions = { controls?: React.ReactNode; commands?: React.ReactNode; status?: React.ReactNode; diagnostics?: React.ReactNode; children?: React.ReactNode };
type Action = 'get' | 'list' | 'save' | 'remove';
type Format = 'text' | 'json' | 'bigint' | 'date';
type Ticket = { promise?: Promise<void> };
type Outcome = { token: object; steps: string[]; message?: string; failure?: string; item?: SPFxConfigurationStoreItem; items?: SPFxConfigurationStoreItem[] };
const useStyles = makeStyles({ payload: { overflowX: 'auto', maxWidth: '100%', minWidth: 0 } });
export function Demo({ render, resetRevision = 0 }: { render?: (regions: DemoRegions) => React.ReactElement; resetRevision?: number } = {}): React.ReactElement {
  const styles = useStyles();
  const page = useSPFxPageContext();
  const { client } = useSPFxSPHttpClient();
  const instance = useSPFxInstanceInfo();
  const [mode, setMode] = React.useState<SPFxConfigurationStoreMode>('layered');
  const [selectedScope, setScope] = React.useState<SPFxConfigurationStoreScope>('site');
  const scope = mode === 'layered' ? selectedScope : mode;
  const store = useSPFxConfigurationStore({ mode });
  const root = mode !== 'tenant' ? page.site.absoluteUrl.trim().replace(/\/+$/, '') : undefined;
  const web = mode !== 'site' ? page.web.absoluteUrl.trim().replace(/\/+$/, '') : undefined;
  const [action, setAction] = React.useState<Action>('get');
  const [key, setKey] = React.useState('spfx-toolkit-config-demo-disposable');
  const [value, setValue] = React.useState('');
  const [format, setFormat] = React.useState<Format>('text');
  const [replaceDescription, setReplaceDescription] = React.useState(false);
  const [description, setDescription] = React.useState('Disposable configuration store demo item');
  const [consent, setConsent] = React.useState<object>();
  const approval = React.useRef<object>();
  const approve = (next: object | undefined): void => { approval.current = next; setConsent(next); };
  const fingerprint = JSON.stringify([mode, scope, action, key, value, format, replaceDescription, description]);
  const boundary = React.useRef({ resetRevision, client, page, instance: instance.id, root, web, fingerprint, token: {} });
  const previous = boundary.current;
  if (previous.resetRevision !== resetRevision || previous.client !== client || previous.page !== page || previous.instance !== instance.id || previous.root !== root || previous.web !== web || previous.fingerprint !== fingerprint) boundary.current = { resetRevision, client, page, instance: instance.id, root, web, fingerprint, token: {} };
  const token = boundary.current.token;
  const mounted = React.useRef(true);
  const ledger = React.useRef(new Set<Ticket>());
  const sequence = React.useRef<object>();
  const latest = React.useRef(0);
  const [, refresh] = React.useState(0);
  const [outcome, setOutcome] = React.useState<Outcome>();
  const [confirmation, setConfirmation] = React.useState<{ confirm: () => void; cancel: () => void; key: string; scope: SPFxConfigurationStoreScope }>();
  const confirmationRef = React.useRef<{ token: object; owner: object; settle: (value: boolean) => void }>();
  const focus = React.useRef<{ trigger: HTMLButtonElement; owns: () => boolean }>();
  const current = (): boolean => mounted.current && boundary.current.token === token && (root === undefined || page.site.absoluteUrl.trim().replace(/\/+$/, '') === root) && (web === undefined || page.web.absoluteUrl.trim().replace(/\/+$/, '') === web);
  React.useLayoutEffect(() => { mounted.current = true; return () => { mounted.current = false; confirmationRef.current?.settle(false); confirmationRef.current = undefined; }; }, []);
  React.useLayoutEffect(() => {
    if (confirmationRef.current && confirmationRef.current.owner !== token) { confirmationRef.current.settle(false); confirmationRef.current = undefined; setConfirmation(undefined); }
  }, [token]);
  React.useLayoutEffect(() => { const request = focus.current; if (!confirmation && request && sequence.current === undefined && ledger.current.size === 0 && !request.trigger.disabled) { focus.current = undefined; if (request.owns() && request.trigger.isConnected) request.trigger.focus(); } });
  const resetSeen = React.useRef(resetRevision);
  React.useLayoutEffect(() => {
    if (resetSeen.current !== resetRevision) {
      resetSeen.current = resetRevision; approve(undefined); setOutcome(undefined); setMode('layered'); setScope('site'); setAction('get'); setKey('spfx-toolkit-config-demo-disposable'); setValue(''); setFormat('text'); setReplaceDescription(false); setDescription('Disposable configuration store demo item');
    }
  }, [resetRevision]);
  const busy = (): boolean => ledger.current.size > 0 || sequence.current !== undefined || confirmationRef.current !== undefined;
  const locked = busy();
  const updateDraft = (changed: boolean, update: () => void): void => {
    if (!changed || !current() || busy()) return;
    // Retire old admission before React can batch the changed draft with old consent/Run.
    boundary.current = { ...boundary.current, token: {} }; approve(undefined); update();
  };
  const disposable = key.startsWith('spfx-toolkit-config-demo-') && key.length > 'spfx-toolkit-config-demo-'.length;
  const visible = current() && outcome?.token === token ? outcome : undefined;
  const askRemoval = (destination: SPFxConfigurationStoreScope, trigger: HTMLButtonElement, owns: () => boolean): Promise<boolean> => new Promise(resolve => {
    const confirmationToken = {};
    confirmationRef.current = { token: confirmationToken, owner: token, settle: resolve };
    const close = (accepted: boolean): void => {
      if (!owns() || confirmationRef.current?.token !== confirmationToken || ledger.current.size > 0) return;
      confirmationRef.current = undefined; focus.current = { trigger, owns }; setConfirmation(undefined); resolve(accepted);
    };
    setConfirmation({ key, scope: destination, confirm: () => close(true), cancel: () => close(false) });
  });
  const run = async (trigger: HTMLButtonElement, recipe = false): Promise<void> => {
    if (!current() || busy() || !store.isReady || (action !== 'list' && !key)) return;
    const mutating = recipe || action === 'save' || action === 'remove';
    if (mutating && (!disposable || approval.current !== token || (recipe && mode !== 'layered'))) return;
    const operation = ++latest.current, sequenceToken = {};
    const owns = (): boolean => current() && latest.current === operation;
    const steps: string[] = [];
    if (mutating) { sequence.current = sequenceToken; approve(undefined); refresh(count => count + 1); }
    setOutcome({ token, steps: [], message: recipe ? 'Running recipe...' : action === 'get' ? 'Reading...' : action === 'list' ? 'Loading physical inventory...' : 'Preparing mutation...' });
    const mark = (message: string, data: { item?: SPFxConfigurationStoreItem; items?: SPFxConfigurationStoreItem[] } = {}): void => {
      if (!owns()) return;
      steps.push(message); setOutcome(previousOutcome => ({ ...(previousOutcome?.token === token ? previousOutcome : { token }), ...data, token, steps: [...steps], message }));
    };
    const write = async (dispatch: () => Promise<void>): Promise<boolean> => {
      if (!owns() || ledger.current.size > 0) return false;
      const ticket: Ticket = {}; ledger.current.add(ticket); refresh(count => count + 1);
      const release = (): void => { ledger.current.delete(ticket); if (mounted.current) refresh(count => count + 1); };
      let promise: Promise<void>;
      try { promise = dispatch(); ticket.promise = promise; } catch (error) { release(); throw error; }
      // The ORIGINAL public promise owns every internal RPC, including lazy discovery and setup.
      await promise.finally(release); return owns();
    };
    try {
      if (recipe) {
        if (!await write(() => store.save(key, 20, { scope: 'tenant' }))) return;
        mark('Saved tenant default 20.');
        if (!owns() || !await write(() => store.save(key, 50, { scope: 'site', description: 'Local override' }))) return;
        mark('Saved site override 50.');
        if (!owns()) return; const item = await store.get<unknown>(key); if (!owns()) return;
        mark('Read the effective site override.', { item });
        const removeSite = (): Promise<void> => store.remove(key, { scope: 'site' });
        if (!owns() || !await askRemoval('site', trigger, owns) || !owns()) { mark('Site removal cancelled; completed writes remain.'); return; }
        if (!await write(removeSite)) return;
        mark('Removed only the site override.');
        if (!owns()) return; const inherited = await store.get<unknown>(key); if (!owns()) return;
        mark('Read the tenant default after removal.', { item: inherited });
      } else if (action === 'get') {
        const item = await store.get<unknown>(key); if (owns()) mark(item ? `Found ${key}.` : `${key} not found.`, { item });
      } else if (action === 'list') {
        const items = await store.listScope(scope); if (owns()) mark(`Loaded ${items.length} ${scope} physical item(s).`, { items });
      } else if (action === 'save') {
        const input: unknown = format === 'json' ? JSON.parse(value) : format === 'bigint' ? BigInt(value) : format === 'date' ? new Date(value) : value;
        if (input instanceof Date && Number.isNaN(input.getTime())) throw new Error('Enter a valid Date.');
        if (await write(() => store.save(key, input, replaceDescription ? { scope, description } : { scope }))) mark(`Saved ${key} in ${scope}.`);
      } else {
        const removeCaptured = (): Promise<void> => store.remove(key, { scope });
        if (await askRemoval(scope, trigger, owns) && owns() && await write(removeCaptured)) mark(`Removed ${key} from ${scope}. Read again to resolve inheritance.`);
      }
    } catch (error) { if (owns()) setOutcome(previousOutcome => ({ ...(previousOutcome?.token === token ? previousOutcome : { token, steps: [] }), failure: error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error) })); }
    finally { if (sequence.current === sequenceToken) sequence.current = undefined; if (mounted.current) refresh(count => count + 1); }
  };
  // Tie Fluent disabledFocusable to the exact disabled flag: return focus after consumed consent without enabling invocation.
  const shown = (value: unknown): string => (JSON.stringify(value) ?? String(value)) + (value === '' ? ' (empty string)' : '');
  const runDisabled = !store.isReady || locked || (action !== 'list' && !key) || (action === 'save' || action === 'remove') && (!disposable || consent !== token);
  const recipeDisabled = !store.isReady || locked || mode !== 'layered' || !disposable || consent !== token;
  const regions: DemoRegions = {
    controls: <>
      <Field label="Mode"><Select aria-label="Mode" disabled={locked} value={mode} onChange={(_, data) => updateDraft(data.value !== mode, () => setMode(data.value as SPFxConfigurationStoreMode))}><option value="layered">Tenant defaults with site overrides</option><option value="site">Site collection only</option><option value="tenant">Tenant only</option></Select></Field>
      <Field label="Operation"><Select aria-label="Operation" disabled={locked} value={action} onChange={(_, data) => updateDraft(data.value !== action, () => setAction(data.value as Action))}><option value="get">Read effective value</option><option value="list">Physical inventory</option><option value="save">Save</option><option value="remove">Remove</option></Select></Field>
      <Field label="Physical scope"><Select aria-label="Physical scope" disabled={locked || mode !== 'layered'} value={scope} onChange={(_, data) => { if (data.value !== 'site' && data.value !== 'tenant' || mode !== 'layered' && data.value !== mode) return; updateDraft(data.value !== scope, () => setScope(data.value as SPFxConfigurationStoreScope)); }}><option value="site" disabled={mode === 'tenant'}>Site collection</option><option value="tenant" disabled={mode === 'site'}>Tenant app catalog</option></Select></Field>
      <Field label="Key"><Input aria-label="Key" disabled={locked} value={key} onChange={(_, data) => updateDraft(data.value !== key, () => setKey(data.value))}/></Field>
      {action === 'save' && <><Field label="Value format"><Select aria-label="Value format" disabled={locked} value={format} onChange={(_, data) => updateDraft(data.value !== format, () => setFormat(data.value as Format))}><option value="text">Text</option><option value="json">JSON</option><option value="bigint">Big integer</option><option value="date">Date (ISO)</option></Select></Field>
        <Field label="Value"><Input aria-label="Value" disabled={locked} value={value} onChange={(_, data) => updateDraft(data.value !== value, () => setValue(data.value))}/></Field>
        <Checkbox label="Replace/clear destination description" disabled={locked} checked={replaceDescription} onChange={(_, data) => updateDraft((data.checked === true) !== replaceDescription, () => setReplaceDescription(data.checked === true))}/>
        <Field label="Description"><Input aria-label="Description" disabled={locked || !replaceDescription} value={description} onChange={(_, data) => updateDraft(data.value !== description, () => setDescription(data.value))}/></Field></>}
      <Text as="p">Manual {action}: scope {scope}, key {key}, format {format}, value {JSON.stringify(value)}, {replaceDescription ? `replace description with ${JSON.stringify(description)}` : 'preserve destination description'}. Recipe: tenant 20 (preserve description), site 50 (Local override), then remove only site, at this same exact key. Tenant means this captured discovery session, not the current web as catalog.</Text>
      <Checkbox label="I consent to these exact disposable mutations" disabled={locked || !disposable} checked={consent === token} onChange={(_, data) => { if (current() && !busy()) approve(data.checked === true ? token : undefined); }}/>
    </>,
    commands: <><Button appearance="primary" disabled={runDisabled} disabledFocusable={runDisabled} onClick={event => run(event.currentTarget)}>Run</Button><Button disabled={recipeDisabled} disabledFocusable={recipeDisabled} onClick={event => run(event.currentTarget, true)}>Run default and override recipe</Button></>,
    status: <>{ledger.current.size > 0 && <Text role="status">Previous write still pending</Text>}{visible?.failure ? <Text role="alert">{visible.failure}</Text> : <Text role="status">{visible?.message ?? 'Not run'}</Text>}{visible && <ol aria-label="Completed configuration steps">{visible.steps.map((step, index) => <li key={index}>{step}</li>)}</ol>}</>,
    children: <><dl><dt>Mode (required)</dt><dd>{mode}</dd><dt>Physical scope</dt><dd>{scope}</dd><dt>Collection root URL</dt><dd>{page.site.absoluteUrl}</dd><dt>Current web URL</dt><dd>{page.web.absoluteUrl}</dd><dt>Discovery web URL</dt><dd>{web ?? '(not used in site mode)'}</dd><dt>Provider instance</dt><dd>{instance.id}</dd><dt>Client ready</dt><dd>{String(store.isReady)}</dd><dt>Current read pending</dt><dd>{String(visible !== undefined && store.isLoading)}</dd><dt>Current write pending</dt><dd>{String(visible !== undefined && store.isWriting)}</dd>
      {visible?.item && <><dt>Source</dt><dd>{visible.item.source}</dd><dt>Selected key</dt><dd>{visible.item.key}</dd><dt>Selected value</dt><dd>{shown(visible.item.value)}</dd><dt>Value type</dt><dd>{typeof visible.item.value}</dd><dt>Description</dt><dd>{visible.item.description ?? '(not set)'}</dd><dt>Physical item ID</dt><dd>{visible.item.id}</dd></>}</dl>
      {visible?.items && <><Text>Inventory count: {visible.items.length}</Text><dl aria-label="First ten configuration records">{visible.items.slice(0, 10).map((item, index) => <React.Fragment key={index}><dt>{item.key}</dt><dd>{item.source} / {item.id}: {shown(item.value)}</dd></React.Fragment>)}</dl></>}
      <Dialog open={confirmation !== undefined} onOpenChange={(_, data) => { if (!data.open) confirmation?.cancel(); }}><DialogSurface><DialogBody><DialogTitle>Confirm physical removal</DialogTitle><DialogContent>Remove exact key {confirmation?.key} only from {confirmation?.scope}, collection root {root ?? '(not used)'}, captured tenant discovery web {web ?? '(not used)'}. No other scope is removed.</DialogContent><DialogActions><Button onClick={confirmation?.cancel}>Cancel</Button><Button appearance="primary" onClick={confirmation?.confirm}>Confirm removal</Button></DialogActions></DialogBody></DialogSurface></Dialog>
    </>,
    diagnostics: <><Text as="p">Read is effective; inventory and changes target one physical store. Only Save may initialize that store. Objects replace whole records; false, zero, empty and legacy null remain overrides. Physical catalog URL is unavailable through this facade. No canWrite is supplied. Manual Save/Remove never automatically reads. Remove a site override then Read again to see tenant defaults. Tenant cleanup requires a separate explicit consented tenant Remove. Reset restores local drafts and hides outcomes; the original public operation may continue. No cancellation, rollback, transaction or lock across scenarios is provided.</Text><div role="region" aria-label="Configuration payload" tabIndex={0} className={styles.payload}><pre>{JSON.stringify(visible, undefined, 2)}</pre></div></>,
  };
  return render ? render(regions) : <section aria-label="Configuration exploration">{regions.controls}{regions.commands}{regions.status}{regions.children}{regions.diagnostics}</section>;
}
export const demo = { host: 'webPart', kind: 'write', contentPlacement: 'configuration', observe: 'Compare tenant, site and layered reads with physical inventories and explicitly scoped consented changes.' };
```

#### Compose tenant defaults and site overrides with the service

```tsx
import * as React from 'react';
import { Button, Checkbox, Dialog, DialogActions, DialogBody, DialogContent, DialogSurface, DialogTitle, Field, Input, Text, makeStyles } from '@fluentui/react-components';
import { createSPFxConfigurationStoreService, useSPFxInstanceInfo, useSPFxPageContext, useSPFxSPHttpClient } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit';
import type { SPFxConfigurationStoreItem } from '@apvee/spfx-react-toolkit';
type DemoRegions = { controls?: React.ReactNode; commands?: React.ReactNode; status?: React.ReactNode; diagnostics?: React.ReactNode; children?: React.ReactNode };
type Ticket = { promise?: Promise<void> };
type Outcome = { token: object; steps: string[]; message?: string; failure?: string; item?: SPFxConfigurationStoreItem; items?: SPFxConfigurationStoreItem[] };
const useStyles = makeStyles({ payload: { overflowX: 'auto', maxWidth: '100%', minWidth: 0 } });
export function Demo({ render, resetRevision = 0 }: { render?: (regions: DemoRegions) => React.ReactElement; resetRevision?: number } = {}): React.ReactElement {
  const page = useSPFxPageContext();
  const { client } = useSPFxSPHttpClient();
  const instance = useSPFxInstanceInfo();
  const styles = useStyles();
  const mode = 'layered';
  const root = page.site.absoluteUrl.trim().replace(/\/+$/, '');
  const web = page.web.absoluteUrl.trim().replace(/\/+$/, '');
  // Required mode and both relevant URLs are supplied explicitly; construction sends no requests.
  const service = React.useMemo(() => client && root && web ? createSPFxConfigurationStoreService(client, { mode, siteCollectionUrl: root, discoveryWebUrl: web }) : undefined, [client, root, web]);
  const [key, setKey] = React.useState('spfx-toolkit-config-demo-service');
  const [consent, setConsent] = React.useState<object>();
  const approval = React.useRef<object>();
  const approve = (next: object | undefined): void => { approval.current = next; setConsent(next); };
  const boundary = React.useRef({ resetRevision, client, page, instance: instance.id, root, web, key, token: {} });
  const previous = boundary.current;
  if (previous.resetRevision !== resetRevision || previous.client !== client || previous.page !== page || previous.instance !== instance.id || previous.root !== root || previous.web !== web || previous.key !== key) boundary.current = { resetRevision, client, page, instance: instance.id, root, web, key, token: {} };
  const token = boundary.current.token;
  const mounted = React.useRef(true);
  const ledger = React.useRef(new Set<Ticket>());
  const sequence = React.useRef<object>();
  const latest = React.useRef(0);
  const [, refresh] = React.useState(0);
  const [outcome, setOutcome] = React.useState<Outcome>();
  const [confirmation, setConfirmation] = React.useState<{ confirm: () => void; cancel: () => void; key: string }>();
  const confirmationRef = React.useRef<{ token: object; owner: object; settle: (value: boolean) => void }>();
  const focus = React.useRef<{ trigger: HTMLButtonElement; owns: () => boolean }>();
  const current = (): boolean => mounted.current && boundary.current.token === token && page.site.absoluteUrl.trim().replace(/\/+$/, '') === root && page.web.absoluteUrl.trim().replace(/\/+$/, '') === web;
  React.useLayoutEffect(() => { mounted.current = true; return () => { mounted.current = false; confirmationRef.current?.settle(false); confirmationRef.current = undefined; }; }, []);
  React.useLayoutEffect(() => { if (confirmationRef.current && confirmationRef.current.owner !== token) { confirmationRef.current.settle(false); confirmationRef.current = undefined; setConfirmation(undefined); } }, [token]);
  React.useLayoutEffect(() => { const request = focus.current; if (!confirmation && request && sequence.current === undefined && ledger.current.size === 0 && !request.trigger.disabled) { focus.current = undefined; if (request.owns() && request.trigger.isConnected) request.trigger.focus(); } });
  const resetSeen = React.useRef(resetRevision);
  React.useLayoutEffect(() => { if (resetSeen.current !== resetRevision) { resetSeen.current = resetRevision; approve(undefined); setOutcome(undefined); setKey('spfx-toolkit-config-demo-service'); } }, [resetRevision]);
  const busy = (): boolean => ledger.current.size > 0 || sequence.current !== undefined || confirmationRef.current !== undefined;
  const locked = busy();
  const disposable = key.startsWith('spfx-toolkit-config-demo-') && key.length > 'spfx-toolkit-config-demo-'.length;
  const visible = current() && outcome?.token === token ? outcome : undefined;
  const run = async (trigger: HTMLButtonElement, recipe: boolean): Promise<void> => {
    if (!current() || busy() || !service || !key || recipe && (!disposable || approval.current !== token)) return;
    const operation = ++latest.current, sequenceToken = {};
    const owns = (): boolean => current() && latest.current === operation;
    const steps: string[] = [];
    if (recipe) { sequence.current = sequenceToken; approve(undefined); refresh(count => count + 1); }
    setOutcome({ token, steps: [], message: recipe ? 'Running service recipe...' : 'Reading...' });
    const mark = (message: string, data: { item?: SPFxConfigurationStoreItem; items?: SPFxConfigurationStoreItem[] } = {}): void => {
      if (!owns()) return;
      steps.push(message); setOutcome(previousOutcome => ({ ...(previousOutcome?.token === token ? previousOutcome : { token }), ...data, token, steps: [...steps], message }));
    };
    const write = async (dispatch: () => Promise<void>): Promise<boolean> => {
      if (!owns() || ledger.current.size > 0) return false;
      const ticket: Ticket = {}; ledger.current.add(ticket); refresh(count => count + 1);
      const release = (): void => { ledger.current.delete(ticket); if (mounted.current) refresh(count => count + 1); };

      mark('Read the tenant default after removal.', { item: inherited });
    } catch (error) { if (owns()) setOutcome(previousOutcome => ({ ...(previousOutcome?.token === token ? previousOutcome : { token, steps: [] }), failure: error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error) })); }
    finally { if (sequence.current === sequenceToken) sequence.current = undefined; if (mounted.current) refresh(count => count + 1); }
  };
  // Tie Fluent disabledFocusable to the exact disabled flag: return focus after consumed consent without enabling invocation.
  const shown = (value: unknown): string => (JSON.stringify(value) ?? String(value)) + (value === '' ? ' (empty string)' : '');
  const readDisabled = !service || locked || !key;
  const recipeDisabled = !service || locked || !disposable || consent !== token;
  const regions: DemoRegions = {
    controls: <>
      <Field label="Key"><Input aria-label="Key" disabled={locked} value={key} onChange={(_, data) => { if (!current() || busy() || data.value === key) return; boundary.current = { ...boundary.current, key: data.value, token: {} }; approve(undefined); setKey(data.value); }}/></Field>
      <Text as="p">Required mode layered, collection root {root}, captured discovery web {web}, provider instance {instance.id}. This public factory composes tenant defaults and site overrides. Consent: exact key {key}, tenant numeric 20 (preserve description), site numeric 50 with Local override description, remove only that site override. Tenant is the captured logical app-catalog session.</Text>
      <Checkbox label="I consent to these exact disposable mutations" disabled={locked || !disposable} checked={consent === token} onChange={(_, data) => { if (current() && !busy()) approve(data.checked === true ? token : undefined); }}/>
    </>,
    commands: <><Button disabled={readDisabled} disabledFocusable={readDisabled} onClick={event => run(event.currentTarget, false)}>Read effective value</Button><Button appearance="primary" disabled={recipeDisabled} disabledFocusable={recipeDisabled} onClick={event => run(event.currentTarget, true)}>Run service recipe</Button></>,
    status: <>{ledger.current.size > 0 && <Text role="status">Previous write still pending</Text>}{visible?.failure ? <Text role="alert">{visible.failure}</Text> : <Text role="status">{visible?.message ?? 'Not run'}</Text>}{visible && <ol aria-label="Completed configuration steps">{visible.steps.map((step, index) => <li key={index}>{step}</li>)}</ol>}</>,
    children: <><dl><dt>Mode (required)</dt><dd>{mode}</dd><dt>Collection root URL</dt><dd>{root}</dd><dt>Discovery web URL</dt><dd>{web}</dd><dt>Provider instance</dt><dd>{instance.id}</dd>{visible?.item && <><dt>Source</dt><dd>{visible.item.source}</dd><dt>Selected key</dt><dd>{visible.item.key}</dd><dt>Selected value</dt><dd>{shown(visible.item.value)}</dd><dt>Value type</dt><dd>{typeof visible.item.value}</dd><dt>Description</dt><dd>{visible.item.description ?? '(not set)'}</dd><dt>Physical item ID</dt><dd>{visible.item.id}</dd></>}</dl>
      {visible?.items && <><Text>Inventory count: {visible.items.length}</Text><dl aria-label="First ten configuration records">{visible.items.slice(0, 10).map((item, index) => <React.Fragment key={index}><dt>{item.key}</dt><dd>{item.source} / {item.id}: {shown(item.value)}</dd></React.Fragment>)}</dl></>}
      <Dialog open={confirmation !== undefined} onOpenChange={(_, data) => { if (!data.open) confirmation?.cancel(); }}><DialogSurface><DialogBody><DialogTitle>Confirm site override removal</DialogTitle><DialogContent>Remove exact key {confirmation?.key} only from site collection {root}. Tenant default remains in the captured logical app-catalog session.</DialogContent><DialogActions><Button onClick={confirmation?.cancel}>Cancel</Button><Button appearance="primary" onClick={confirmation?.confirm}>Confirm removal</Button></DialogActions></DialogBody></DialogSurface></Dialog>
    </>,
    diagnostics: <><Text as="p">Physical catalog URL is unavailable through this facade. Construction is request-free and tenant discovery is lazy. Physical inventory never merges scopes or deduplicates IDs. Whole-record overrides and destination-local metadata apply. Only Save can initialize its chosen store. Completed steps remain facts when a later read fails. No transaction, rollback or cancellation is provided. Reset retains the service and the original pending-write tickets; the lock is local to this mounted Demo. Tenant cleanup is separate, explicitly scoped and consented; this recipe never removes tenant data.</Text><div role="region" aria-label="Configuration service payload" tabIndex={0} className={styles.payload}><pre>{JSON.stringify(visible, undefined, 2)}</pre></div></>,
  };
  return render ? render(regions) : <section aria-label="Configuration service">{regions.controls}{regions.commands}{regions.status}{regions.children}{regions.diagnostics}</section>;
}
export const demo = { host: 'webPart', kind: 'write', contentPlacement: 'configuration', observe: 'Write a tenant default and site override, inspect their provenance and inventory, then remove only the site override.' };
```

After Cancel or Escape, consumed consent stays revoked. The commands conditionally use Fluent `disabledFocusable` with the same disabled condition, so focus can return to the current trigger while the command remains unavailable. Its live ownership and consent guards still reject invocation; returning focus does not approve another write.
